correctness.rationale: For no initial tricolored hub triangle the three initial hub cases give extinction at or before time four. A tricolored hub triangle remains a rotating oscillator. The full finite-radius checker verifies equality of center states at times four and seven in all 3*3^15 possible forced-hub initial windows, and finite speed proves sufficiency for every wheel order; the hub itself is already three-periodic. Only periods one and three remain. Standard cyclic-word transfer matrices S and T then count precisely extinct basins and globally rotating period-three states. Independent exhaustive direct graph evolution for all 265680 labelled configurations on n=3..10 matches both counts, and symbolic characteristic polynomials are checked.

value.rationale: The two naturally different objects (eventual extinction population versus number of initially recurrent primitive three-cycles) have separate exact transfer spectra. Their leading exponential constants 1+sqrt(2) and 2.205569... are unequal; hence almost every initial state approaches a cycle in at most four updates while almost none begins periodic. This quantitative two-scale phenomenon is not furnished by the general prior circulation criterion and motivates both exact enumerations.
